title: HomeKit Weekly: Homey secures Matter 1.5 certification to expand bridging and energy support - 9to5Mac
summary: Through the Matter Bridge app, Homey allows users to expose non-Matter devices to Apple Home/HomeKit, Google Home, Amazon Alexa, SmartThings, and Home Assistant. Homey is one of the few smart home products certified for Matter 1.5.
